Use case: stylized-concept

Primary request: Automation architecture represented by a compact kinetic routing machine that turns one incoming object into an ordered sequence of coordinated outcomes.

Subject: A handcrafted system of wheels, gates, channels, and cyan glass beads, with one orange trigger lever and several neatly delivered output forms.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe machine silhouette; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: precise, efficient, quietly ingenious
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
